_schema: WHIR PCS per-stage config. The per-stage 'stacking' flag selects the commit mode,
and each stage lists ONLY the fields its mode actually reads (so nothing here is dead).
Top-level PIOP/sumcheck:
use_algebraic_decomp - enable algebraic-decomposition optimization in linear sumcheck rounds.
Common (both modes):
log_blowup             - RS code rate = 1/2^log_blowup.
grinding_bits_query    - query-phase proof-of-work bits.
grinding_bits_batching - batching-phase proof-of-work bits.
stacking               - false = non-stacking (Jagged); true = stacking (SWIRL/cross-round).
path_pruning           - share Merkle paths across queries to shrink the proof (orthogonal to stacking).
Non-stacking stages (stacking=false) additionally use:
num_queries            - single global arity-2 query count (the security driver; early-stop is off).
Stacking stages (stacking=true) additionally use:
num_committed_groups   - number of cross-round IOPP folding groups.
round_query_counts     - per-group query counts (the security driver).
grinding_bits_folding  - per-fold proof-of-work bits (JBR compensation).
log_final_poly_len     - FRI early-stop: stop once poly has 2^this evals.
stack_log_height       - commit-local stack height; null = auto (tallest matrix). KoalaBear only.
Root shrink hash:
KoalaBear root_shrink currently uses SHA256 for the final PCS Merkle hash via RootSC;
this is a Rust type-level selection, not a JSON runtime switch.
Switching a stage's mode: stacking-only params for non-stacking stages were removed for clarity;
the code carries hardcoded defaults (WHIR_<STAGE>_* consts) so flipping 'stacking' to true still
works (it falls back to those defaults). Re-add explicit values here if you need non-default ones.
Env overrides: WHIR_<STAGE>_STACKING, WHIR_<STAGE>_PATH_PRUNING / DT_USE_PATH_PRUNING, etc.
